# KataGo Remote One-Click v0.1.3

Adds private link management, removes the single-client limit, and rounds out Analysis Engine compatibility.

## Highlights

- **Concurrent clients**: the bridge no longer closes new connections with `1013 Try Again Later`. LizzieYzy Next, KaTrain, and other Analysis Engine clients can connect simultaneously and share one KataGo process.
- **Isolated sessions**: every connection keeps its own session, query-ID space, and route table, so clients may reuse the same query IDs without interfering. Disconnecting a client only cancels its own queries.
- **No per-client query limit**: a client may keep any number of analyses in flight, as before. KataGo's `numAnalysisThreads` setting still bounds how many searches run in parallel.
- **Scoped `terminate_all`**: the action now terminates only the requesting session's analyses instead of every analysis on the engine.
- **Query ID replacement**: resending an active query ID now terminates the previous KataGo query and replaces it instead of returning `query id is already active`.
- **Human SL model**: optional `-human-model` support through `KATAGO_REMOTE_HUMAN_MODEL=1` (auto-download), `KATAGO_REMOTE_HUMAN_MODEL_PATH`, or `katago-remote init --human-model`. This enables KaTrain's `humanSLProfile` queries.
- **Private link management**: multiple links with per-link client limits.
  - `katago-remote link create [--max-clients N]` (`-1` unlimited, `0` disabled, `N` cap).
  - `katago-remote link list`, `katago-remote link set <id> --max-clients N`, `katago-remote link delete <id>`.
  - Links live in `state/links.json` with mode `600`. The server reloads it every two seconds, so edits close affected sessions without a restart.
  - The legacy `state/access-token` is migrated into an unlimited link, so existing URLs keep working. `reset-link` now rotates the first link.
  - `katago-remote show` lists every link and prints a QR code for the first one.

Clients share the GPU. Two simultaneous analyses each run at roughly half speed, and the total is limited by the server's compute. The private path token remains the only access control, so anyone with the complete WSS link can open a session.

## Upgrade

```bash
curl -fsSLo /tmp/katago-remote-install.sh \
  https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ykrsama/katago-remote-one-click/v0.1.3/install.sh
bash /tmp/katago-remote-install.sh
```

Existing KataGo, model, analysis config, fixed-hostname settings, and the private link are reused.
